text:
Dear Harbor Logistics team,

I own the shipment tracking platform at my current company, where I developed a set of Go services that efficiently process carrier events through Kafka, reconcile them against PostgreSQL, and expose a real-time API that serves forty thousand merchants. I'm eager to bring this expertise to the Senior Backend Engineer role at Harbor Logistics, where I can support your routing and warehouse systems with my background in building reliable backend solutions.

In my current position, I successfully led the migration from a monolithic architecture to event-driven services without any downtime. This not only improved system reliability but also enhanced performance by reducing the 99th percentile latency of the tracking API from 900 milliseconds to just 120 milliseconds. Solving the issue of duplicated deliveries, I introduced idempotent consumers that have since stabilized the system against similar failures.

Furthermore, I set up observability tools that include tracing and SLO dashboards, thereby improving our team's ability to monitor system health and troubleshoot effectively. As part of my responsibilities, I run the on-call rotation for six engineers, ensuring that our immediate support structures are robust and efficient.

As a mentor to two mid-level engineers, I am committed to fostering growth and technical excellence within the team. I also contribute to our architecture decision records and participate in the interview process for new developers, further advancing team cohesion and skill development. I look forward to potentially bringing this blend of experience and my passion for operational excellence to Harbor Logistics.

Sincerely,
